verdict.rationale: Asana's vendor docs describe pre-built AI Teammates/agents that work within workflows with shared memory and context, plus AI Studio for no-code automation and an 'AI Chief of Staff' (Dash) product, which supports delegating tasks to built-in AI assistants. However, these are first-party marketing claims without independent/hands-on corroboration or detail on how task delegation actually works in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of AI Teammates/Dash functioning as claimed, concrete examples of task delegation workflows, and community hands-on feedback on the AI assistant features specifically.
